title: qa screen map (one file under qa/map/)
description: How to reach each screen and what to capture there. A file is an object with an optional area, named flows and screens. Selectors are Playwright selectors, with role plus accessible name first; $seed.* tokens name seeded records so no id lives in the map.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors

area.description: Area for the file's screens; a screen's area is this, or the file's basename when omitted

flows.description: Named step lists, global across map files. Reused by name from a screen's flow or a { flow } step. Names may not start with login:

screen.description: One screen: how to reach it and what to capture there

name.description: Screen name; used in capture file names and in --only globs

role.description: A key of qa.json login; the walk logs in as that role before any step

flow.description: Flow name walked before steps: a name from flows, or a built-in login:<role>

steps.description: Steps run after the flow; a screen needs flow, steps, or both

viewports.description: Viewport names this screen is walked at; omitted means every viewport

modes.description: Profile mode names to walk this screen in; accepted now, walked from step 3

record.description: Record the walk on video, with click rings

watch.description: Default CSS selector of elements to crop separately on every capture of this screen

tour.description: The tour on this screen's last capture: false turns it off; an object's options merge over qa.json tour

open.description: Extra selectors of controls to open

skip.description: Selectors of controls never to open

requestOverrides.description: Network requests to answer with fixed JSON instead of the real response

url.description: URL of the request to override

json.description: JSON body to answer the request with

origin.description: Who added the screen, e.g. "verify:<slug>"; such screens can be pruned

sources.description: Globs of the source files this screen covers

expectData.description: qa ready: text (or /re/flags) a row of seeded data shows on this screen; a capture without it is an empty-data screen

emptyOk.description: qa ready: true when the empty state is the point of this entry (an empty search), so it is never an empty-data screen

step.description: One step: exactly one action key, plus its modifiers

goto.description: Navigate to a path or URL, e.g. "/candidates"

click.description: Click the matched element. Playwright selector; prefer role=<role>[name="<accessible name>"]

clickAll.description: Click every matched element, in order. Playwright selector; prefer role=<role>[name="<accessible name>"]

fill.description: Type the step's value into the matched field. Playwright selector; prefer role=<role>[name="<accessible name>"]

setFiles.description: Set the files of the matched file input (see files). Playwright selector; prefer role=<role>[name="<accessible name>"]

clearStorage.description: Remove browser storage keys matching this regex, or each regex in an array

hover.description: Hover over the matched element. Playwright selector; prefer role=<role>[name="<accessible name>"]

press.description: Press a keyboard key on the page, e.g. "Enter"

waitFor.description: Wait until the matched element is visible. Playwright selector; prefer role=<role>[name="<accessible name>"]

capture.description: Capture the screen under this state name; the name becomes part of the file name

flow.description: Call a named flow inline; its steps are spliced in at this point

tour.description: Run the tour at this point of the walk: true, or options that merge over qa.json tour

value.description: The text or number that fill types into the field; $seed.* tokens are resolved in it

files.description: File path, or array of paths, that setFiles sets on the input

optional.description: Modifier: the step times out after 3 s and its failure is ignored

watch.description: Modifier on capture: CSS selector (document.querySelectorAll) of elements to crop separately

expandEach.description: Modifier on capture: Playwright selector of toggles clicked open, one at a time, before capture. Prefer role=<role>[name="<accessible name>"]
